reviews.title: This app is great, the amount of ads is not…
reviews.text: Simple and straight to the point, the app is amazing. It’s got a whole bunch of really cool, cute, and unique features and widgets and the pets are really cute. However, the amount of ads it shoves in your mouth is ridiculous. If you want an ad free experience, you have to pay a pretty expensive subscription, no way of doing one time payments. An ad for simply opening the app, ads for getting food for the pets. And they eat so much, you’re forced to watch even more long ads(can reach 113s of videos and then on top of that a mini game in the ad after). There’s premium food which the pets sometimes ask for and you can’t receive unless you pay real money, and if you don’t feed them that specific food they need to eat more! There’s another alternative which is to spend an egregious amount of time playing subpar mini games on the app to get a couple of coins per try. It takes too long. They’re not very entertaining. If you’re ok with spending more time watching ads than interacting with the app then go for it. Because the rest of it is actually great, unfortunately it’s wayyy too intrusive and annoying for me. And that subscription is too expensive, on top of there being no one time purchases.

reviews.title: Gets Boring After a While
reviews.text:
Widgetable sounds great in concept, and the UI designs are very cute and easy to use. When I first downloaded it along with 2 of my friends, we used it everyday. Our favorite feature was taking care of our pets.

But that SAME pet-care feature is what ruined this app for me. Both of my friends took care of 4 pets with me (making me take care of a total of 8 pets). I was constantly running out of food and forced to watch the longest ads ever (hey, aren’t they supposed to be only 30 seconds?) before my pet ran away from home. Even my friends, who only had to care for 4 pets on their side, found it overwhelming!

The constant pressure for you, the user, to watch ads killed the app’s fun for us. Gradually, we stopped going on the app because we KNOW we will be forced to watch ads the entire time. This discouraged us from using the other functions available. By the third week, I already stopped using Widgetable’s other functions completely. I basically thought of the other features as useless now.

Also, it is true you can use coins to buy food. The question is, HOW?? I maybe just didn’t play this app enough but the only way to earn coins was by completing “offers”. Those offers don’t even work, okay? I did one and never got my coins, and I followed all the instructions.

Overall, I don’t recommend this app. It is good for casual fun but really makes you frustrated after a while.
